title: Lost in the Grid: Where Multimodal LLMs Fail Between Seeing and Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.34152v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at static visual understanding and are increasingly applied to spatial planning, where a model interprets a visual layout and outputs an action sequence to reach a goal. Grid games are a common testbed for this ability because their rules are explicit and a solver can verify every move. Yet existing benchmarks mostly report end-to-end success rates, which hide whether a failure stems from visual perception, rule application, or multi-step planning. We introduce GridProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that 1) locates the failing stage between visual perception and planning and 2) verifies the diagnosis by targeted fine-tuning. On Sokoban, GridProbe pairs end-to-end solving with four probes (recognition, localization, single-step prediction, and state tracking) and gives every board both as an image and as an equivalent text grid. translated_title: 迷失在网格中：多模态大语言模型在“看见”与“规划”之间的失败之处
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在静态视觉理解方面表现出色，并越来越多地被应用于空间规划任务，即模型解读视觉布局并输出动作序列以达成目标。网格游戏是测试这种能力的常用试验平台，因为其规则明确，且求解器可以验证每一步移动。然而，现有基准大多只报告端到端成功率，掩盖了失败究竟源于视觉感知、规则应用还是多步规划。我们提出GridProbe，一个诊断性基准，它能够：1）定位视觉感知与规划之间出现失败的环节；2）通过针对性微调验证诊断结果。在推箱子任务上，GridProbe将端到端求解与四项探测任务（识别、定位、单步预测和状态追踪）相结合，并以图像和等价文本网格两种形式呈现每个棋盘。在推箱子和一个迷宫游戏上对七个多模态大语言模型进行评估，揭示了各不相同的……
tldr: 该论文提出GridProbe诊断基准，通过四项探测任务定位多模态大语言模型在空间规划任务中失败的具体环节（视觉感知或规划），并以针对性微调验证诊断结果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GridProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that localizes where multimodal LLMs fail in spatial planning—between visual perception and multi-step planning—and verifies the diagnosis through targeted fine-tuning.
